description: OpenAI has scrapped the release of GPT-6.1 Astra, a next-generation artificial intelligence model planned for an October debut, after internal testing found the system did not meet the company's ‌safety and alignment standards, the ChatGPT maker confirmed on Monday.
title: OpenAI scraps release of new AI model over safety concerns

author: Amir Said
description: Plans for high-speed rail service between Calgary, Red Deer and Edmonton are moving forward with new commitments from the governments of Alberta and Canada. The province says it is preparing to launch a formal process for private-sector proponents of the rail project to submit proposals, and the federal government has committed to referring the project to Ottawa's Major Projects Office.
title: Calgary-Edmonton high-speed rail project moves forward with new commitments from Alberta, feds

description: After months of threatening tariffs and possible military action to acquire Greenland, U.S. President Donald Trump signed an Arctic security pact with the leaders of Denmark and Greenland. Andrew Chang explains how this deal updates the long-standing 1951 defence agreement but falls short of an outright U.S. takeover, and why experts question if the diplomatic fallout was worth the result. CORRECTION: At 08:31, there is a photo of an airplane at Nuuk airport. It should show an image of a Naval port in Greenland. (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
title: Did Donald Trump get what he wanted in Greenland? | About That

author: Raffy Boudjikanian
description: The RCMP are among more than a half-dozen police forces probing a threat sent to Islamic schools across the country.
title: RCMP confirm investigation into death threat sent to Muslim schools

description: At least two people were killed when a drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday, as Russia pounded the heart of the Ukrainian capital with some of the most persistent drone strikes since the start of the war.
title: Ukraine hit with deadly wave of Russian drone strikes in Kyiv and across the country

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: Investigators in New York are reopening an investigation into an alleged gang rape at Cornell University after a woman filed a lawsuit claiming the university didn't do enough to protect her.
title: What to know about Cornell's alleged frat house gang-rape case and the 'Cornell 7'

author: Bradley van Paridon
description: RCMP have charged a 17-year-old in Lethbridge, Alta., with multiple offences related to terrorism, child sexual abuse and exploitation material, and animal cruelty. The accused’s online activity was consistent with the designated terrorist group 764, investigators say.
title: Alberta youth charged with terrorism offences related to violent online group 764

author: Paul Tukker
description: Kutryk, who is heading to the International Space Station later this week, has credited Ted Hupé, his former Grade 6 teacher in Yukon, with inspiring "the explorer within me."
title: Retired Yukon teacher in Florida to see former student Joshua Kutryk launch into space

author: Jim Bronskill
description: Advocacy groups say Canadians deserve basic facts about the weapons used in the February mass shooting in northeast B.C.
title: RCMP says it still won't share more details on firearms used in Tumbler Ridge shooting

description: Canada's population saw a slight bump in 2025, Statistics Canada says, revising a previous estimate that showed the population decreased for the first time in the country's history.
title: Canada did not see historic population decline last year, StatsCan says after second look

description: A Dutch man whose journey from cybercriminal to reformed security professional was widely covered in the international media has been arrested ‌as part of an investigation into the hacker group ShinyHunters, Dutch police and the man's boss said on Monday. The news comes on the heels of ShinyHunters hacking the FBI last week.
title: Dutch police arrest security professional in ShinyHunters investigation

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Ads for a documentary about controversial billionaire Elon Musk have reportedly been banned from both TikTok and X but, after brief delays, are now running on YouTube and Meta's social media platforms.
title: TikTok, X reportedly barring ads for documentary about Elon Musk

author: Catharine Tunney
description: The FBI is offering $1 million US for information leading to the arrest of a top lieutenant in the Lawrence Bishnoi gang accused of orchestrating the June 2023 assassination of Sikh activist Hardeep Singh Nijjar in Surrey, B.C.
title: FBI adds Bishnoi gang member accused of ordering murder of B.C. Sikh activist to most-wanted list

author: Nicole Brockbank
description: Self-described 'Crypto King' Aiden Pleterski’s criminal fraud and money laundering trial will begin next week, after the trial judge denied a request to delay it on Monday in Ontario's Superior Court of Justice.
title: 'Crypto King' Aiden Pleterski will represent himself at his fraud trial next week

description: An airstrike carried out by Myanmar's military near a market in territory controlled by a powerful rebel group killed at least 33 people and wounded 36 others on Monday, the group and a rescue official said.
title: Myanmar military airstrike hits market, killing at least 33 people in Rakhine state

description: SpaceX launched its enormous Starship into orbit for the first time Monday and successfully delivered the most advanced Starlinks yet, but decided to cut short the flight.
title: SpaceX sends giant Starship into orbit for the first time but ends the flight early

author: Nicole Brockbank
description: An alleged drug trafficker accused of obtaining confidential information from a Toronto police officer, which investigators say was used in an unsuccessful conspiracy to kill a senior corrections official, was denied bail again Monday.
title: Alleged drug trafficker denied bail again in Toronto police corruption case

description: The Competition Bureau says consumers expect grocers to be able to advertise their "best deals."
title: Competition Bureau investigates minimum advertised pricing policies in grocery sector

author: Kate Bueckert
description: Guelph Mayor Cam Guthrie says this year's off-campus homecoming parties impacted the entire community and were among the worst they've seen in terms of resources needed to respond to it. Other cities in Ontario have also had their share of grief in dealing with unsanctioned student parties.
title: Homecoming parties in Guelph 'worst' yet and 'impacted the entire community,' mayor says

description: At least 62 people have died after days of heavy rain and flooding in northern India's Uttar Pradesh state, officials said Monday.
title: Heavy rain, flooding kill at least 62 in northern India

author: Jonathan Ore
description: All Elite Wrestling announced the death of Satterly, better known by his in-ring mononym PAC, on their social media channels Sunday night. No cause of death was released.
title: Benjamin Satterley, English pro wrestler known as Pac, dead at 40

description: Taylor Swift became the most-awarded artist in VMA history, Madonna won multiple times and people paid tribute to the late Dolly Parton at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards.
title: Multiple generations honoured at MTV VMAs as Taylor Swift, Madonna win, Dolly Parton and Nirvana remembered

author: Jorge Barrera
description: The families of the victims in one of Mexico’s most infamous atrocities say it’s time for the Claudia Sheinbaum government to release all of the information it holds about the role the military played in the disappearance of 43 students from a teachers' college in Ayotzinapa, Guerrero.
title: Families demand Mexico reveal full details of military role in disappearance of 43 students

author: Jessica Campbell
description: Experts warn Meta's Sturgeon County data centre could put pressure on Alberta energy prices, despite assurances from Meta and the provincial government that Albertans won't see higher bills.
title: Will Meta’s data centre raise Alberta power bills? Experts say it could

author: Chris Iorfida
description: The Mighty Sparrow, the Grenada-born, Trinidadian-raised musician who helped export calypso to the masses beginning in the 1950s, has died. He was 91.
title: The Mighty Sparrow, Caribbean music legend, dead at 91

author: Richard Deitsch
description: The last two months of the season for Toronto’s WNBA franchise was a gruelling, slow-motion march simply trying to navigate an injury-depleted roster. Still, there were memorable on-court highlights and much to look forward to entering the franchise's second off-season.
title: 'Only up from here': Tempo's off-court success offers optimism after injury-ravaged inaugural campaign

description: British police were questioning five men on Monday on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences after their detention near ‌an airbase used by the U.S. to strike Iran.
title: British police question 5 suspects after arrests near airbase used by U.S.

description: Residents of Mexico's Baja California Sur state boarded up homes and workers hauled dirt and rubble to shore up embankments as Hurricane Polo bore down on the peninsula Monday, threatening high winds, floods and mudslides. Meanwhile, Hurricane Nolo could still bring torrential rain to parts of Hawaii even as the storm edged away from the state.
title: Hurricane Polo threatens Mexico's Pacific coast with landfall expected today

author: Bryce Hoye
description: The elusive former head of Manitoba's lone law school — who'd been in the wind since being disbarred 2½ years ago — racked up millions in debt in Switzerland before he was recently picked up by police in France.
title: Disgraced former Manitoba law dean racked up millions in Swiss debt ahead of France arrest, documents suggest

author: Shaina Luck, Angela MacIvor
description: For the first time, Nova Scotia is tracking how many youth in care run away. In the last year, group homes have reported hundreds of incidents where youth went missing and were considered at “imminent risk,” a problem the provincial department in charge acknowledges is a major concern.
title: Missing and at risk: Why children in care often run from group homes

author: Frances Willick
description: Fiddlehead Market Co-op opened in Bear River, N.S. — population 1,000 — in July. Members say the prices, the quality of the produce and the convenience are a breath of fresh air.
title: This tiny N.S. community was frustrated with big-box grocers. So they opened their own store

description: Rescue teams on Monday searched for a dozen people swept away by an avalanche that killed at least two others on a Nepalese mountain during severe weather.
title: Rescue teams search Nepal mountain for 12 swept away by avalanche

author: Nick Logan
description: Some plastic surgeons in Canada and elsewhere say they're seeing more people coming in for consultations with AI-modified images of themselves, seeking cosmetic procedures that work t
title: Can I get AI face? Plastic surgeons say AI-generated inspiration is more than meets the eye

author: Benjamin Shingler
description: With the Parti Québécois leading in the polls and promising a third referendum, the party is facing questions about the economic impact of Quebec independence — and a new study on Alberta separation offers a sobering point of comparison.
title: How much would Quebec independence cost? An Alberta study offers clues

author: Nicole Brockbank, Angelina King
description: Some of the Toronto police officers charged in the Project South corruption probe were allegedly seen drinking and doing drugs in their vehicles while under surveillance. Determining when to intervene in these kinds of scenarios is a balancing act, say experts, but public safety is always the "paramount consideration" for investigators.
title: How police balance surveillance with public safety in investigations like Project South

author: Faith Greco
description: Prescription opioids meant to help people struggling with addiction are increasingly turning up in drug investigations in northern Ontario, according to police. The issue is a concern in other parts of Canada as well.
title: Police in northern Ontario want tighter safer-supply rules to keep prescription opioids off streets

author: Murray Brewster
description: Former defence chief Wayne Eyre considered quitting "several times" as he battled the Trudeau government over military misconduct, defence spending and support for Ukraine. His candid memoir recounts political clashes, frustration with Ottawa's "inability to make decisions at the speed of war."
title: 'Thrown under the bus': Former defence chief's memoir lays bare his battles with the Trudeau government

author: Mike Crawley
description: The Canada-U.S. trade war is playing out amid a tight race for U.S. Senate in Maine. The election result will help determine which party controls Congress for the remainder of Donald Trump's term as president.
title: Trump's tariffs are unpopular in Maine. A Republican senator may pay the price
